text:
maria: Heads up - noticed spike in provisional token credits for hosted customer after toolcall retry + truncation. Looks like routing fallback to cheaper model caused double-charge when stream resumed.
ryan: ugh saw same on infra metrics. stack: client stream -> router -> modelA then fallback to modelB mid-stream due to node OOM
sanjay: is this the one where we truncate suffix and then re-emit toolcall? that's our old dupe window
maria: yes. logs show stream_id=abc123 got EOF then reconnect, router assigned new model; ledger created provisional credits for both
anya: console shows provisional=240, confirmed=120 for same session. customers confused :grimacing:
ops-bot: alert #billing-high-provisional triggered for customer prod-foo
ryan: possible fixes: 1) de-dup by session+prefix hash 2) only provisional-credit on final ack 3) route sticky-affinity on reconnect
sanjay: option2 breaks low-latency streaming for clients that expect immediate provisional tracking
maria: we could add a short grace-window (500ms) during reconnect to stitch prefixes; ledger already has timestamping
anya: UX: change console to surface 'stitch attempts' and mark provisional as 'may be provisional due to retry'
ryan: implement router change: carry original session_hint through fallback and include in billing tag
maria: small PoC: patch router to propagate client.session_id header when swapping models; can we ship in canary?
anya: create console flag to show provisional vs confirmed with tooltip. I'll mock
sanjay: need to add unit test: stream resume with truncation scenario ensure single-charge
ryan: also add telemetry metric 'reconnect_stitch_success' and 'provisional_trim_count'
maria: timeline? can we do canary tomorrow?
anya: I'll send a design in product channel, pull this into next sprint
sanjay: putting placeholders for tests and telemetry on PR
ryan: ok I'll open PR for router header propagation + route tag
maria: thanks everyone. followups: add sample logs snippet
maria: ```
INFO stream_resume stream_id=abc123 prev_offset=420 reconnect_offset=420 model=classic fallback_to=compact session_id=customer:bar
WARN model_restart node=gpux1 reason=OOM
INFO ledger provisional credit 120 session_id=customer:bar tag=router=v2
INFO ledger provisional credit 120 session_id=customer:bar tag=router=v1
```
anya: perfect, ping me when PR's ready :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploybot started canary deploy for router v2
maria: closing thread, will follow on PR comments
